description:
[Reasons] The company's decision reasons (why a candidate was rejected or withdrew, kind reject / withdraw) and position status reasons (the reason_id set_interview_state needs for on_hold and cancelled, with the lifecycles each applies_to). type narrows to one; include_archived=true adds the archived ones. A company has six default position status reasons from the moment the position lifecycle is on.

Every argument in full, with examples: get_tool_reference.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

include_archived.description: true: also the archived reasons, which past decisions keep but are no longer offered.

kind.description: Decision reasons only: reject or withdraw.

language.description: Language of a decision reason's display_label (default en).

llm_model.description: Your model id, e.g. "claude-opus-4-8"; "unknown" if unsure. For analytics.

merchant_id.description: Optional merchant to scope to. Admins and sub-merchant operators only; other callers always use their token's merchant.

type.description: Only one type: decision (reject / withdraw reasons) or position_status (the reason_id of a position lifecycle change). Left out: both, without a type the company has switched off.

name: list_reasons
title: List the company's reasons
